text:
Married at first glance, the bride Jacqui Burfoot was staggering after her husband Ryan brutally classified her third in a controversial task last week.
But now experts reveal that the situation was even more messy behind the scene.
During the Explosive Ranking Challenge, Jacqui, 29, placed Ryan, 36 years old, confidently, at the top of his list, just for his new husband to discard it with a cold dose of “honesty” that left the producers fighting for a reaction.
“Jacqui was crying, but not for the reason they made him see,” said a source close to Jacqui to Daily Mail Australia.
“He was not injured that Ryan put his third: he was upset for being paired with a man who lacked emotional intelligence or depth to really put it first.”
According to privileged information, Jacqui never waited for Ryan to place her first, believing that she was around fourth in her eyes.
